title: Introduce an eligibility module
request: Create a pure function for order eligibility rules.

overview.summary: Define the rules in a new module without introducing side effects.
overview.architecture: The proposed module owns rule evaluation. Existing submission services would call it in a subsequent change.
questions: What order and customer types should the function accept?

annotations.title: Create the eligibility module
annotations.intent: Export a pure validateOrder function that returns eligibility and a reason.
annotations.rationale: Keep reusable business rules separate from transport and persistence.
alternatives: Place rules directly in the service if they will never be reused.
